verdict.rationale: Unstructured is a document-processing and ETL platform. Its AI features produce derived outputs from your data: VLM or agentic table-to-HTML, generative OCR, image descriptions, named entities, and LLM-based schema extraction. These are AI-generated enrichments, not insights or suggestions about the data surfaced inside the product, and the 'discover hidden insights' line is marketing about connectors rather than an analysis feature. Missing for 10: any in-product AI analysis, summaries, recommendations or suggestions over the user's data, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
